verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־ אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- ’ay·ye·leṯ haš·ša·ḥar miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ê·lî ’ê·lî lā·māh ‘ă·zaḇ·tā·nî rā·ḥō·wq mî·šū·‘ā·ṯî diḇ·rê ša·’ă·ḡā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of The Doe of the Dawn A Psalm of David My God my God why have You forsaken me Why are You so far from saving me so far from my words of groaning

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא־ דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hay ’eq·rā yō·w·mām wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·neh wə·lay·lāh wə·lō- ḏū·mî·yāh lî
verses.literal: I cry out by day O my God but You do not answer . . . and by night but I have no rest

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh qā·ḏō·wōš yō·wō·šêḇ tə·hil·lō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Yet You are holy enthroned on the praises of Israel

verses.original: בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵā bā·ṭə·ḥū ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū bā·ṭə·ḥū wat·tə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·mōw
verses.literal: In You our fathers trusted they trusted and You delivered them

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא־ בֽוֹשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·le·ḵā zā·‘ă·qū wə·nim·lā·ṭū bə·ḵā ḇā·ṭə·ḥū wə·lō- ḇō·wō·šū
verses.literal: They cried out to You and were set free they trusted in You and were not disappointed

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא־ אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ wə·lō- ’îš ḥer·paṯ ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·zui ‘ām
verses.literal: But I am a worm and not a man scorned by men and despised by the people

verses.original: כָּל־ רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- rō·’ay yal·‘i·ḡū lî yap̄·ṭî·rū ḇə·śā·p̄āh yā·nî·‘ū rōš
verses.literal: All who see me mock me they sneer . . . and shake their heads

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: gōl ’el- Yah·weh yə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·hū yaṣ·ṣî·lê·hū kî ḥā·p̄êṣ bōw
verses.literal: He trusts in the LORD let the LORD deliver him let the LORD rescue him since He delights in him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל־ שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ḡō·ḥî mib·bā·ṭen maḇ·ṭî·ḥî ‘al- šə·ḏê ’im·mî
verses.literal: Yet You brought me forth from the womb You made me secure at my mother’s breast

verses.original: עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·le·ḵā hā·šə·laḵ·tî mê·rā·ḥem mib·be·ṭen ’im·mî ’ê·lî ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: From birth I was cast upon You from my mother’s womb You have been my God

verses.original: אַל־ תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי־ צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי־ אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tir·ḥaq mim·men·nî kî- ṣā·rāh qə·rō·w·ḇāh kî- ’ên ‘ō·w·zêr
verses.literal: Be not far from me for trouble is near and there is no one to help

verses.original: סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî pā·rîm rab·bîm ’ab·bî·rê ḇā·šān kit·tə·rū·nî
verses.literal: Many bulls surround me strong bulls of Bashan encircle me

verses.original: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ṣū ‘ā·lay pî·hem ’ar·yêh ṭō·rêp̄ wə·šō·’êḡ
verses.literal: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul

verses.original: כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל־ עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kam·ma·yim niš·paḵ·tî wə·hiṯ·pā·rə·ḏū kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāy hā·yāh lib·bî kad·dō·w·nāḡ nā·mês bə·ṯō·wḵ mê·‘āy
verses.literal: I am poured out like water and all my bones are disjointed My heart is like wax it melts away within me

verses.original: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ׀ כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר־ מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇêš ka·ḥe·reś kō·ḥî ū·lə·šō·w·nî muḏ·bāq mal·qō·w·ḥāy wə·la·‘ă·p̄ar- mā·weṯ tiš·pə·ṯê·nî
verses.literal: My strength is dried up like a potsherd and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth You lay me in the dust of death

verses.original: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî kə·lā·ḇîm ‘ă·ḏaṯ mə·rê·‘îm hiq·qî·p̄ū·nî kā·’ă·rî yā·ḏay wə·raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: For dogs surround me a band of evil men encircles me they have pierced my hands and feet

verses.original: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ־ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·sap·pêr kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāy hêm·māh yab·bî·ṭū yir·’ū- ḇî
verses.literal: I can count all my bones they stare and gloat over me

verses.original: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל־ לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥal·lə·qū ḇə·ḡā·ḏay lā·hem wə·‘al- lə·ḇū·šî yap·pî·lū ḡō·w·rāl
verses.literal: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־ תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh ’al- tir·ḥāq ’ĕ·yā·lū·ṯî lə·‘ez·rā·ṯî ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: But You O LORD be not far off O my Strength come quickly to help me

verses.original: הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד־ כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣî·lāh mê·ḥe·reḇ nap̄·šî mî·yaḏ- ke·leḇ yə·ḥî·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: Deliver my soul from the sword my precious life from the power of wild dogs

verses.original: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî mip·pî ’ar·yêh ū·miq·qar·nê rê·mîm ‘ă·nî·ṯā·nî
verses.literal: Save me from the mouth of the lion at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me

verses.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·sap·pə·rāh šim·ḵā lə·’e·ḥāy bə·ṯō·wḵ qā·hāl ’ă·hal·le·kā
verses.literal: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers I will praise You in the assembly

verses.original: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ הַֽלְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־ זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּהוּ וְג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’ê Yah·weh hal·lū·hū kāl- ze·ra‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ kab·bə·ḏū·hū wə·ḡū·rū mim·men·nū kāl- ze·ra‘ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You who fear the LORD praise Him All descendants of Jacob honor Him All offspring of Israel revere Him . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא־ הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ḇā·zāh wə·lō šiq·qaṣ ‘ĕ·nūṯ ‘ā·nî wə·lō- his·tîr pā·nāw mim·men·nū ū·ḇə·šaw·wə·‘ōw ’ê·lāw šā·mê·a‘
verses.literal: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted He has not . . . hidden His face from him but has attended to his cry for help

verses.original: מֵ֥אִתְּךָ֗ תְֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥י בְּקָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’it·tə·ḵā ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî bə·qā·hāl rāḇ nə·ḏā·ray ’ă·šal·lêm ne·ḡeḏ yə·rê·’āw
verses.literal: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You

verses.original: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים׀ וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: yō·ḵə·lū ‘ă·nā·wîm wə·yiś·bā·‘ū yə·hal·lū Yah·weh dō·rə·šāw yə·ḥî lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem lā·‘aḏ
verses.literal: The poor will eat and be satisfied those who seek the LORD will praise Him May your hearts live forever

verses.original: יִזְכְּר֤וּ׀ וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כָּֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yiz·kə·rū wə·yā·šu·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ wə·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kāl- miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ gō·w·yim
verses.literal: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD All the families of the nations will bow down before Him

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ham·mə·lū·ḵāh ū·mō·šêl bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations

verses.original: אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ׀ כָּֽל־ דִּשְׁנֵי־ אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל־ יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵə·lū way·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū kāl- diš·nê- ’e·reṣ lə·p̄ā·nāw yiḵ·rə·‘ū kāl- yō·wr·ḏê ‘ā·p̄ār wə·nap̄·šōw lō ḥî·yāh
verses.literal: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him even those unable to preserve their lives

verses.original: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ra‘ ya·‘aḇ·ḏen·nū yə·sup·par la·ḏō·nāy lad·dō·wr
verses.literal: Posterity will serve Him they will declare the Lord to a new generation

verses.original: יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḇō·’ū wə·yag·gî·ḏū ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw lə·‘am nō·w·lāḏ kî ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn all that He has done
